steps.prompt: Chairs go in rows of $6$. There are $42$ chairs. How many rows? Which times fact did you use?

cards.title: Undo multiplying
cards.body: Division undoes multiplication. $6 \times ? = 42$: think "six times what is $42$?", or divide: $42 \div 6 = 7$. In $? \div 4 = 9$ the missing number is the whole, so multiply: $9 \times 4 = 36$.

steps.text: Count in eights, or use an anchor: $5 \times 8 = 40$, and $56 - 40 = 16$ is two more eights.

cards.title: A fact family
cards.body: One fact gives four: $7 \times 8 = 56$, $8 \times 7 = 56$, $56 \div 8 = 7$ and $56 \div 7 = 8$. Knowing one means you know them all.

prompts: Write a fact family for one times fact you know well.
